_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- INTERFEROMETER mode: ALMA 12-m Array, Cycle 13 configurations C-1 ... C-10
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/interf/alma/. "derived" = arithmetic done here (shown); "inferred" = a mapping no source states; NOT FOUND listed in not_found.
_meta.quote_check: 246 quote records (181 distinct quotes) machine-checked against the saved files' extracted text (pdftotext -layout and -raw for PDFs, split by page; tag-stripped text and raw source for HTML; the cfg, JSON and .py files as is; the casacore table by decoding its ISM index): all pass (2026-10-20).
_meta.quote_normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), tilde operator, division slash, the ring/bullet degree signs and soft hyphens normalised; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes with PDF line-end hyphenation closed up or with all whitespace removed (table rows); ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces on one page.
_meta.frame: antennas[].e/n/u: metres East/North/Up in the local ENU frame at the array centre lat -23.02917 deg, lon -67.754649 deg (TH Sec. 2.1), ellipsoidal height 5056.8 m (u datum = the CASA reference height). See params.enu_conversion.
_meta.antenna_name: The cfg files carry pad names only (5th column "pad#"); name = pad.
_meta.json_usage: configs["C-5"].antennas -> [{name, e, n, u}]; site.lat_deg for the Earth-rotation tracks; bands[].lo_GHz/hi_GHz/bw_GHz; res_table.rows["C-5"].theta_max_arcsec[k] at res_table.freqs_GHz[k].

enu_conversion.value: e, n, u (metres) = local ENU at the TH array centre (lat -23.02917, lon -67.754649, ellipsoidal height 5056.8 m)
enu_conversion.quote: The array is located on the Chajnantor plain of the Chilean Andes (lat.=–23.02917◦ , long.=–67.754649◦ )
enu_conversion.derived: Each cfg (x, y, z) -> ECEF with the CASA locxyz2itrf formula at the OBS reference (lat -23.022886, lon -67.754929, h 5056.8 m, WGS84 a, b from SIMU) -> ENU at the array centre (WGS84; h = 5056.8 m chosen so u keeps the cfg height datum). The array centre sits at (x, y, z) = (28.723, -696.472, -0.038) m in the cfg LOC frame. The conversion is a rigid rotation + translation (3-D baseline lengths change by < 2e-9 m); it differs from the plain translation e = x - 28.723, n = y + 696.472, u = z + 0.038 by at most 0.912 m (C-10 outer pads; the two tangent planes are 0.0063 deg apart). u is relative to the ellipsoidal height 5056.8 m (the CASA reference height), not to the 5000 m nominal altitude.
enu_conversion.inferred: Taking the TH lat/lon as the "array centre" is a choice: TH calls it the location of the array; no document calls it the centre of a configuration.

C-10 it gives beams 12-24% finer than the tabulated theta_min (e.g. C-10: 0.0409" vs theta_min 0.051", theta_max 0.057"). The Cycle 13 table (new presentation, PG Sec. 1.3) describes the 50-antenna operational configurations (TH Table 7.1 caption), not the C43-X cfg files; Eq. 7.6 does reproduce the MRS table (within 1.0%).
MRS: TH Eq. 7.6 0.983 lambda/L5 (used for PG/TH Tables A-2/7.2) vs Primer "0.6 x (wavelength/minimum baseline)".
Bandwidth: TH 7.5 GHz per polarization (4 x 1.875 GHz usable) vs Primer "16 GHz (2 polarizations x 4 basebands x 2 GHz/baseband)" (nominal 2 GHz basebands, both polarizations).

Site: TH lat -23.02917, lon -67.754649 vs PG -23.029, -67.755 (rounded) vs the CASA LOC origin -23.022886, -67.754929 (696.5 m further north). Altitude 5000 m (TH, PG; rounded) vs 5056.8 m (CASA WGS84 height).

notes: For uv tracks: e, n, u of the antennas are a rigid frame at lat -23.02917 deg; baseline (dE, dN, dU) -> equatorial X = -sin(lat) dN + cos(lat) dU, Y = dE, Z = cos(lat) dN + sin(lat) dU, then the usual (u, v, w) rotation by hour angle and declination (standard; the reproduction of TH Table 7.3 above used exactly this).

TH Eq. 7.6 (theta_MRS ~ 0.983 lambda / L5) with the Table 7.3 L05 reproduces the TH Table 7.2 / PG Table A-2 MRS values within 1.0% (e.g. C-1: 28.4" vs 28.5" at 100 GHz); Eq. 7.4 does not reproduce the Cycle 13 resolution ranges (Conflicts).
Primary beam: FWHM = 1.13 lambda / D (12 m: 58" at 100 GHz, 19.4" at 300 GHz); CASA models it as an Airy pattern scaled to that FWHM; effective blockage 0.75 m.
Peak sidelobe levels (TH Table 7.5, 1-hour observation at Dec -23 deg, notional C43-X) are a validation target for the dirty beam (Briggs 0.5: 6-11%).
